name: In This Article
author: ClikIT

sections.description:
The In This Article plugin is designed to help you list all h2 and h3 headings in the content of a post. These headings are displayed in an ordered structure, allowing users to easily navigate within the post. You can place this list on your single blog post page using a simple shortcode.

Features:

  • Fetches all h2 and h3 headings from the post content.
  • Displays the headings in a hierarchical, clickable list.
  • Easy-to-use shortcode for placing the list anywhere on the posts.
  • Allows smooth scrolling to sections when clicking on a heading.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the [itah_in_this_article] shortcode to any single blog post page where you want the list of headings to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I use the shortcode?

Simply insert [itah_in_this_article] into the content editor of any post or page. This will generate a list of h2 and h3 headings from the content.

Does this plugin support custom post types?

Yes, it works with any content type that uses h2 and h3 headings in the post content.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release of the plugin, providing shortcode support for fetching and displaying h2 and h3 tags from post content.
